name: Alte Mühle
beschreibung: The Alte Mühle in Tyrol is a charming hotel set within a historic former mill building. Its tranquil location on the edge of the village makes it an excellent base for outdoor adventures in nature. The property offers tastefully appointed rooms with modern comforts and picturesque valley views. A key highlight is the regional cuisine served in the in-house restaurant. The mill's historic architectural heritage has been lovingly preserved, with parts of the original grinding mechanism still on display. Guests also have access to a cozy wellness area with a sauna. The hotel appeals primarily to those seeking peaceful accommodation paired with outdoor activities.
